# Billed Right

> Billed Right is a healthcare Revenue Cycle Management company and Enterprise Revenue Performance Partner, founded in 2006 and headquartered in Longwood, Florida. It provides end-to-end RCM services — billing, denial management, credentialing, and revenue-cycle analytics — to healthcare organizations across the United States.

## Services
- [AAPC-Certified Medical Coding Services | Billed Right](https://billedright.com/services/medical-coding/): Accurate medical coding from Billed Right’s AAPC-certified coders: CPT and ICD-10 coding, modifier review, and coding education for medical practices since 2006.
- [Charge Posting Services for Medical Practices | Billed Right](https://billedright.com/services/charge-posting/): Accurate, timely charge posting from Billed Right: error-free charge entry, super bill processing, and clean claim submission since 2006.
- [Credentialing as a Service for Medical Groups | Billed Right](https://billedright.com/services/credentialing/): Billed Right provides fully managed Credentialing as a Service for growing medical groups, including payer enrollment, CAQH, re-credentialing, monitoring, hospital privileges and multi-location support.
- [Insurance A/R Follow-Up Services | Billed Right](https://billedright.com/services/ar-follow-up/): Stop losing revenue to claims stuck in payer processing. Billed Right’s insurance A/R follow-up works every unpaid claim on a set cadence so nothing ages past an appeal deadline, since 2006.
- [Insurance Eligibility Verification Services | Billed Right](https://billedright.com/services/insurance-eligibility/): Prevent claim denials before they start with Billed Right’s insurance eligibility verification: copay, deductible, and CPT coverage confirmed before every visit, since 2006.
- [Medical Billing Account Management Services | Billed Right](https://billedright.com/services/account-management/): Dedicated account management from Billed Right: a single point of contact, weekly calls, and real-time support for your entire revenue cycle since 2006.
- [Medical Billing Claim Submission Services | Billed Right](https://billedright.com/services/claim-submission/): Clean, timely claim submission from Billed Right: accurate electronic and paper claim filing, scrubbing, and clearinghouse management since 2006.
- [Medical Billing Denial Management Services | Billed Right](https://billedright.com/services/denial-management/): Recover denied claims and reduce future denials with Billed Right — systematic denial management, appeals, and root cause analysis since 2006.
- [Medical Billing Payment Posting Services | Billed Right](https://billedright.com/services/payment-posting/): Accurate, timely payment posting from Billed Right: EOB processing, EFT and paper check posting, and real-time reconciliation since 2006.
- [Medical Billing Reporting Services | Billed Right](https://billedright.com/services/reporting/): Clear, actionable medical billing reports from Billed Right: weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting on charges, revenue, aging, and denials since 2006.
- [Medical Billing Services by EMR Platform | Billed Right](https://billedright.com/services/emr-billing-platforms/): Billed Right works inside your existing EMR: eClinicalWorks, AthenaHealth, Central Reach, and IMS. No system change, no migration, no disruption.
- [Medical Documentation Management Services | Billed Right](https://billedright.com/services/documentation-management/): Streamline incoming faxes and document routing with Billed Right — daily fax processing, chart assignment, and document management since 2006.
- [Medical Documentation Review Services | Billed Right](https://billedright.com/services/documentation-review/): Prevent denials and audit risk with Billed Right’s medical documentation review — ensuring every claim is supported by accurate, compliant clinical documentation since 2006.
- [Patient AR Collections Services for Medical Practices | Billed Right](https://billedright.com/services/patient-ar-collections/): Recover outstanding patient balances with Billed Right: patient statements, inbound call handling, and AR follow-up to maximize collections since 2006.
- [Payer Contract Renegotiation Services | Billed Right](https://billedright.com/services/contract-renegotiation/): Maximize payer reimbursements with Billed Right: payer contract analysis, benchmarking against Medicare fee schedules, and renegotiation strategy since 2006.
- [Prior Authorization and Referral Services | Billed Right](https://billedright.com/services/authorizations/): Reduce auth delays and denials with Billed Right: prior authorization submission, tracking, and referral management for medical practices since 2006.
- [RCM & Medical Billing Services | Billed Right](https://billedright.com/services/): From charge entry to payment posting, every step of your revenue cycle handled by specialty-trained billing experts. Explore Billed Right's full suite of RCM services, including Credentialing as a Service.
- [eClinicalWorks Medical Billing Services | Billed Right](https://billedright.com/services/eclinicalworks-billing-services/): Billed Right has worked inside eClinicalWorks for 20 years: setup, billing, reporting, and new practice onboarding. All included, all in your eCW.
